title: Archived sessions take far less space online
summary: Each archived session now stores only what changed since an earlier one, instead of a full copy of the campaign.
items: Ending a session used to store a full copy of the whole campaign each time. Archived sessions are now stored as the changes against an earlier archived copy, which in a typical campaign uses about a fifth of the space.

Nothing changes in how archived sessions look, open or download: every one is rebuilt exactly and checked before it is shown. Archived sessions stored before this change stay as they are and remain readable.
